title: Composed-tree gate: scripts/badf_compose.py simulates the post-merge tree and CI runs it on every PR
objective: Turn the hand-run post-merge simulation into a deterministic script and a named CI gate: compose base + candidate as the squash that would land, point origin/main at it, run repo and the suite there, and refuse unless the ledger sees the landing and everything is green.
business_value: PR #30 was green and its squash turned main red. The simulation has caught nothing since only because a person kept running it; a discipline is not a control.
in_scope: scripts/badf_compose.py (stdlib; clone by SHA; refuse to nest; refuse a message without a Work-Package line; --ci-shape; --tests pattern printed, never silent)
BADF_PROPTECH_PATH honoured by the three host-dependent test modules (CI shape without test-file surgery)
CI step on pull_request with the PR body as the squash message
tests, mutation where meaningful, post-merge simulation run by the new script itself
doctrine: the stated step becomes a named gate
out_of_scope: making compose a gate subcommand (it orchestrates subprocesses; the gate never runs the suite)
blocking merges mechanically beyond the existing required check
acceptance_criteria: compose PASSES on a candidate whose message carries its Work-Package line and whose composed tree is green, and reports the WP as LANDED_UNRECONCILED
compose FAILS when the composed suite fails, naming the failing test
compose FAILS when the composed repo check fails
compose FAILS on a message without a Work-Package line before running anything
compose FAILS on a candidate that does not squash-merge cleanly
compose refuses to nest and writes nothing to the source repository
CI runs compose on pull_request against base.sha + head.sha with the PR body
this PR's own compose run is cited
permissions: write: scratch clones under tmp only

rollback.method: revert the squash commit via PR

note: Lands IN_PROGRESS by design; reconciled by the next WP's branch.
